title: Titanium Propeller Hub Cap
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5, UNS R56400) was selected for this propulsion application because its 900+ MPa tensile enables thin-wall lightweighting under cyclic loading. The alpha-beta microstructure provides 45% higher specific strength than 4140 steel, critical for weight-sensitive designs. Its 6.7 W/mK thermal conductivity simplifies thermal management. This rationale is driven by quiet-running submarine propeller hub cap and service environment demands.
process: Ring forging radial-axial for propulsion geometry
CNC turn-bore operation with Class 6g gauge
TIG welding autogenous with Class 6g gauge
Hydrostatic pressure test with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Heavy-duty passivation 25% HNO3 45min per ASTM B600 for maximum chloride pitting resistance in seawater — tailored for quietrunning submarine propeller application
inspection: PMI positive material ID (quietrunning submarine verified)
commonFailures: Erosion-corrosion at pipe bend <3D radius - remedied by +2mm wall thickness in directional change zones — critical for quietrunning submarine propeller performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Propeller Hub Cap suitable for Quiet-running submarine propeller hub cap?
faq.a: Titanium Propeller Hub Cap uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address propulsion operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Propeller Hub Cap?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Propeller Hub Cap is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for quietrunning submarine propeller requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Propeller Hub Cap require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. quietrunning submarine propeller components require Heavy-duty passivation 25% HNO3 45min per ASTM B600 for maximum chloride pitting resistance in seawater — tailored for quietrunning submarine propeller application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Propeller Hub Cap shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Propeller Hub Cap includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet quietrunning submarine propeller specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.
